Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Simran Dutta. I am a 54-year-old orthopaedic surgeon living in Nagpur. My spouse Asha Agarwal and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of INR 69,50,000/-, and the wife wants her jewellery and gifts returned. My case number is Petition No. 1033/2020 in the Family Court at Nagpur. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 07919733066 or email simran.dutta66@example.com.
